assessment: Building on previous work dissecting the polarisation of a gill arch epithelial ridge (GAER) of a cartilaginous fish (skate), this paper uses RNA–Sequencing, multiplexed HCR, cell fate mapping, and pharmacological manipulation to uncover the contribution of the Wnt signalling pathway to the patterning of the gill arch, highlighting the role tissues boundaries in signalling and patterning embryonic tissues.
